methods.label: Align and slide the set square
methods.explanation: When one leg of the set square coincides with \(l\), the other leg is perpendicular to \(l\). Slide the set square until the other leg passes through \(P\), then draw along it. The resulting line passes through \(P\) and is perpendicular to \(l\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 set-square construction and elementary recognition of a right angle.
